title: January 15–25 — World War II: Battle of Voronezh (1943)
text: World War II, or the Second World War, was a global conflict between two coalitions: the Allies and the Axis powers. Nearly all of the world's countries participated, with many engaging in total war on an unprecedented scale.

title: The Battle of Stalingrad officially ends with General Karl Strecker's surrender to Soviet forces.
text: The Battle of Stalingrad was a major battle on the Eastern Front of World War II in which Nazi Germany and its Axis allies fought the Soviet Union for control of the city of Stalingrad in southern Russia. title: The 26th Anniversary of the October Revolution Celebration Meeting
text: The October Revolution, also known as the Great October Socialist Revolution, October coup, Bolshevik coup, or Bolshevik Revolution, was the second of two revolutions in Russia in 1917. It was led by Vladimir Lenin's Bolsheviks as part of the broader Russian Revolution of 1917–1923.
